content.title: Asia’s AI Boom Faces Reality Check as Foreigners Deepen Selling
content.summary: Foreigners offloaded nearly $4.6 billion each of Taiwanese and Korean equities so far this month, putting them on track for the biggest monthly outflows since March and April, respectively, according to data compiled by Bloomberg.  The retreat marks the latest sign that enthusiasm over Asia’s spectacular artificial intelligence rally is waning as concerns over the valuation run-up and mismatched earnings expectations intensify.  Fading hopes of a Federal Reserve rate cut in December has also tempered risk appetite globally.
